name: Flowing Menu
description: Full-height list menu where a spring-driven colored band follows the cursor across rows, revealing a scrolling marquee of the item text with optional images.
contents: Vertical list of rows, each a link or button with label, optional index number, meta text and arrow icon
Per-row hidden marquee band with repeated text and optional pill, rounded or circle image
Optional dividers between rows and a dot marking the active item
Optional floating band layer that carries content between rows
behavior: Band springs to the hovered row with stretch and magnet lean toward the cursor, and releases to the top or bottom edge on pointer leave
Marquee scrolls inside the band, and cursor horizontal speed adds extra push
Keyboard focus-visible moves the band to the focused row, touch tap moves it on pointer down
Intro animation slides labels up, fades details, draws dividers, then sweeps the band down the rows
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by skipping the intro, springs and marquee movement
Row dimming of inactive rows when dimInactive is on
editableByProps: Menu items: labels, links, meta text, marquee text and images
Marquee speed, direction, cursor push, spring duration, stretch and magnet
Band inset and corner radius, and whether content is carried between rows
Text, background, band, band text and divider colors
Dividers, index numbers, arrows, dimming, left or center alignment, intro on or off
Active item marker, click handler, aria label, className and inline style

needsCodeEdit.where: ArrowUpRight01Icon import and the HugeiconsIcon in the END span
EASE constant and the intro useIsoLayoutEffect with node.animate calls

needsCodeEdit.change: Change font sizes of labels and marquee text

fixed: Fills its parent with h-full w-full, so the parent must have a set height
Rows share the height equally, with a 56px minimum
Uses container query units, so text scales with row size
Needs Tailwind and the hugeicons packages
Animation runs on a custom requestAnimationFrame loop with a spring model
Pointer hover effects are ignored for touch pointers, which use tap instead
A row renders as an anchor when item.link is set, otherwise as a button
Items are keyed by text and index

options.look: Wide oval images in the marquee band
options.useWhen: Menu of landscape project or category thumbnails
Menu showing photo previews of work or destinations
Menu of people, products or avatar-like icons
